title: Question 21
passage:
I thought the market was on the square today.
A. It moved indoors because of the wind. B. I usually bring a shopping bag on Fridays. C. The florist’s stall sells dried flowers, too.
passageZh:
我以為市集今天在廣場。
A. 因為風勢，市集移到室內了。 B. 我星期五通常會帶購物袋。 C. 花攤也有賣乾燥花。
